details:
Q1: Which repository area should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow/pipeline phase—name it and describe the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific script/tool—provide its path or command
C. Documentation—name the page or topic
D. Multiple areas—list the exact bounded scope
Q2: What outcome and acceptance criteria are required?
Choices:
A. Fix a defect—provide actual behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction steps (RECOMMENDED)
B. Change behavior—describe the desired behavior and a success example
C. Internal quality improvement—provide measurable goals and confirm behavior must remain unchanged
